title: Specs and Documentation
blurb: The open Agent Skills format and the official guides that explain how skills are written, discovered and loaded.

title: Official Skill Libraries
blurb: Skill bundles published by the teams who build the platforms, frameworks and services they teach agents to use.

title: Community Collections
blurb: Curated lists and large community catalogs of skills, a good place to browse what exists.

title: Domain Skills and Methodologies
blurb: Focused skill sets for science, marketing, engineering practice and context engineering.

title: Registries and Marketplaces
blurb: Places to search, compare, version and install skills and plugins, from public indexes to enterprise registries.

title: Installers and Authoring Tools
blurb: CLIs, loaders and generators that package, validate and deliver skills to the agent of your choice.

title: Security and Scanning
blurb: Scanners that inspect skills, MCP servers and agent configurations before you trust them.

title: Agent Runtimes with Skills
blurb: Agents and harnesses that load skills or plugins natively.
